item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02595","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final total 22 after correctly writing (56 / 8) + (48 / 6), which yields 15.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 20 - (2 + 4 + 1 + 4) as 11 instead of 9.","reason":"Case 1 supplies an unsupported final number after a correct formula; case 2 explicitly miscalculates a correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02596","case1_error":"Uses an incorrect conversion factor of 1.16 ounces per pound instead of 16.","case2_error":"Prices four chocolate bars using four magazines, although the stated equivalence requires eight magazines.","reason":"Case 1 uses a false unit conversion; case 2 substitutes the chocolate-bar count for the magazine count in the given price equivalence.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02597","case1_error":"Omits the ten additional Saturday rounds, counting only one Saturday round.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the interval from 8 AM to noon as eight hours instead of four.","reason":"Case 1 leaves out an explicitly stated contribution; case 2 miscalculates an elapsed-time expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02598","case1_error":"Performs four halving-and-donation rounds when the question specifies two.","case2_error":"Uses all 500 flowers as the rose count and again as the lily count, charging every flower both prices.","reason":"Case 1 repeats a process too many times; case 2 substitutes a combined count for each distinct category's count.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02599","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 80 - 16 as 40 instead of 64.","case2_error":"Adds dead chickens to purchased chickens instead of adding the surviving chickens.","reason":"Case 1 makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression; case 2 constructs an erroneous total using the wrong population.","judgment":"different"}]}
